questions.prompt: All expense reports must be submitted _____ Friday to receive reimbursement this month.
questions.explanation: by 表示「不晚於某時間」，適合截止期限。
questions.translation: 所有費用報告必須在星期五以前提交，才能於本月收到報銷。

questions.prompt: Ms. Huang is responsible _____ training newly hired employees.
questions.explanation: be responsible for 是「負責……」的固定搭配。
questions.translation: 黃小姐負責訓練新進員工。

questions.prompt: Many customers are interested _____ the company's new membership program.
questions.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配。
questions.translation: 許多顧客對公司的新會員方案有興趣。

questions.prompt: The new software is capable of _____ large amounts of data.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 of 後接名詞或 V-ing，因此選 processing。
questions.translation: 這套新軟體能處理大量資料。

questions.prompt: Ms. Patel _____ director of operations since last January.
questions.explanation: since + 過去時間點常搭配現在完成式。
questions.translation: Patel 女士自去年一月起一直擔任營運主管。

questions.prompt: The outdoor event was canceled _____ heavy rain.
questions.explanation: because of 後接名詞片語；because 後面要接完整子句。
questions.translation: 戶外活動因大雨而取消。

questions.prompt: The downtown branch will remain open, _____ the airport branch will close early.
questions.explanation: whereas 用來對比兩個子句。
questions.translation: 市中心分店會維持營業，相對地機場分店將提早關閉。

questions.prompt: The consultant was _____ recommended by several former clients.
questions.explanation: 修飾過去分詞 recommended 應使用副詞 highly。
questions.translation: 這位顧問受到多名前客戶的高度推薦。

questions.prompt: The company expects online sales to _____ significantly next quarter.
questions.explanation: expect + O + to V；to 後接原形動詞。
questions.translation: 公司預期下一季網路銷售將大幅增加。

questions.prompt: Applicants _____ have at least three years of experience will be given priority.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 applicants 是人，且關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，用 who。
questions.translation: 具備至少三年經驗的申請者將優先錄取。

questions.prompt: The shipment will arrive on time _____ the weather becomes severe.
questions.explanation: unless = if not，語意為「除非天氣惡化」。
questions.translation: 除非天候轉差，貨物將準時抵達。

questions.prompt: _____ several delays, the construction project was completed within budget.
questions.explanation: Despite 後接名詞片語 several delays。
questions.translation: 儘管多次延誤，工程仍在預算內完成。

questions.prompt: Final _____ from the finance department is required before the purchase can be made.
questions.explanation: 形容詞 final 後需接名詞 approval。
questions.translation: 完成採購前，需要財務部門的最終核准。

questions.prompt: The new filing system allows employees to locate documents more _____.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 locate 應用副詞 efficiently。
questions.translation: 新的歸檔系統讓員工能更有效率地找到文件。

questions.prompt: The orientation session is scheduled _____ at 9:30 A.M.
questions.explanation: be scheduled to V 表示「預定做……」。
questions.translation: 新生訓練預定上午九點半開始。

questions.prompt: Either the sales manager or her assistants _____ attending the trade show.
questions.explanation: either A or B 的動詞通常與較近主詞 assistants 一致，用 are。
questions.translation: 銷售經理或她的助理們將出席商展。

questions.prompt: Neither the printer nor the copy machines _____ functioning properly.
questions.explanation: 較近主詞 copy machines 為複數，因此用 are。
questions.translation: 印表機與影印機目前都無法正常運作。

questions.prompt: The seminar will cover not only customer service but also _____ management.
questions.explanation: not only A but also B 要平行；customer service 與 time management 都是名詞片語。
questions.translation: 研討會不只涵蓋客服，也會談時間管理。

questions.prompt: Additional information _____ available on the company's website.
questions.explanation: information 是不可數名詞，視為單數。
questions.translation: 更多資訊可在公司網站取得。

questions.prompt: By the time the manager arrived, the interview panel _____ the final candidate.
questions.explanation: 較早發生的過去動作使用過去完成式。
questions.translation: 經理抵達時，面試小組早已選定最後一位候選人。

questions.prompt: The company installed energy-efficient lighting _____ electricity costs.
questions.explanation: 不定詞可表示目的：「為了降低」。
questions.translation: 公司安裝節能照明以降低電費。

questions.prompt: _____ the quarterly report, Mr. Diaz sent it to the board members.
questions.explanation: 先完成報告再寄出，用 having + p.p. 表示先發生。
questions.translation: 完成季度報告後，Diaz 先生將它寄給董事會成員。

questions.prompt: The updated policy, _____ was announced yesterday, takes effect immediately.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 policy 是物，非限定關係子句用 which。
questions.translation: 昨天公布的更新政策立即生效。

questions.prompt: Customers _____ orders were damaged will receive replacements at no charge.
questions.explanation: whose 表示所有關係：「顧客的訂單」。
questions.translation: 訂單受損的顧客將免費收到替換品。

questions.prompt: The annual meeting, at _____ shareholders vote on major proposals, will be held in June.
questions.explanation: at which = at the meeting，正式書面用法。
questions.translation: 股東將對重大提案投票的年度會議將於六月舉行。

questions.prompt: If I _____ in charge of the project, I would revise the schedule.
questions.explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞正式用 were。
questions.translation: 如果我是專案負責人，我會修改時程。

questions.prompt: _____ we known about the road closure, we would have taken another route.
questions.explanation: 先還原為 If we had known about the road closure。省略 if 後，將 had 移到主詞 we 前面，形成 Had we known；這是與過去事實相反的條件倒裝。
questions.translation: 如果早知道道路封閉，我們就會走另一條路。

questions.prompt: All applications must _____ electronically through the company portal.
questions.explanation: 申請文件是被提交，因此用 must be submitted。
questions.translation: 所有申請必須透過公司入口網站以電子方式提交。

questions.prompt: Of the three candidates interviewed, Ms. Walker was the _____ qualified.
questions.explanation: 三者以上比較使用最高級 most qualified。
questions.translation: 三名受訪候選人中，Walker 女士最符合資格。

questions.prompt: The new procedure requires _____ steps than the previous one.
questions.explanation: steps 是可數複數，使用 fewer。
questions.translation: 新流程比舊流程需要更少步驟。

questions.prompt: There is very _____ time left before the registration deadline.
questions.explanation: time 是不可數名詞，使用 little。
questions.translation: 距離報名截止時間只剩很少時間。

questions.prompt: The first printer is out of order, so please use _____ one.
questions.explanation: another + 單數名詞，表示「另一個」。
questions.translation: 第一台印表機故障，請使用另一台。

questions.prompt: Each of the conference participants _____ a name badge.
questions.explanation: each 作主詞時視為單數。
questions.translation: 每位與會者都會收到名牌。

questions.prompt: The survey received _____ responses from overseas customers.
questions.explanation: responses 為可數複數，用 many。
questions.translation: 這項調查收到許多海外顧客的回覆。

questions.prompt: No personal calls are permitted _____ working hours.
questions.explanation: during + 名詞片語 working hours。
questions.translation: 工作時間內禁止私人通話。

questions.prompt: Please return the signed agreement _____ ten business days.
questions.explanation: within 表示「在某段期間之內」。
questions.translation: 請在十個工作天內交回已簽署的協議。

questions.prompt: _____ the weather forecast, the storm should pass by noon.
questions.explanation: according to 表示「根據……」。
questions.translation: 根據天氣預報，暴風雨應在中午前通過。

questions.prompt: _____ the base salary, employees receive transportation allowances.
questions.explanation: in addition to + 名詞，表示「除了……之外還有」。
questions.translation: 除基本薪資外，員工也會收到交通津貼。

questions.prompt: The company revised its policy _____ customer feedback.
questions.explanation: in response to 表示「回應、因應」。
questions.translation: 公司因應顧客回饋修改政策。

questions.prompt: Ms. Reed accepted the award _____ the entire design team.
questions.explanation: on behalf of 表示「代表……」。
questions.translation: Reed 女士代表整個設計團隊領獎。

questions.prompt: Full-time employees are eligible _____ health insurance benefits.
questions.explanation: be eligible for 是「有資格獲得……」。
questions.translation: 全職員工有資格享有健康保險福利。

questions.prompt: Are you familiar _____ the updated reservation system?
questions.explanation: 人 be familiar with 物，表示熟悉某物。
questions.translation: 你熟悉更新後的預約系統嗎？

questions.prompt: This model is similar _____ the one released last year.
questions.explanation: be similar to 是固定搭配。
questions.translation: 這款型號與去年推出的款式相似。

questions.prompt: Management is aware _____ the technical issue and is working on a solution.
questions.explanation: be aware of 是固定搭配。
questions.translation: 管理層已知悉技術問題，正著手解決。

questions.prompt: Most clients were satisfied _____ the revised proposal.
questions.explanation: be satisfied with 是固定搭配。
questions.translation: 大多數客戶對修訂後的提案感到滿意。

questions.prompt: The delay was due _____ an unexpected equipment failure.
questions.explanation: be due to 表示「由於」。
questions.translation: 延誤是由突發設備故障造成。

questions.prompt: The store will remain open _____ the renovation work.
questions.explanation: regardless of 表示「不論、不受……影響」。
questions.translation: 商店不受裝修工程影響，仍會營業。

questions.prompt: All visitors must register at the front desk prior _____ entering the laboratory.
questions.explanation: prior to + N/V-ing，表示「在……之前」。
questions.translation: 所有訪客進入實驗室前都必須在櫃台登記。

questions.prompt: The committee has not decided _____ the event will be held indoors or outdoors.
questions.explanation: whether...or... 表示「是否……或……」。
questions.translation: 委員會尚未決定活動要在室內或室外舉行。

questions.prompt: The instructions were rewritten _____ new users could understand them more easily.
questions.explanation: so that + 子句，表示目的。
questions.translation: 說明已重新撰寫，以便新使用者更容易理解。

questions.prompt: The purchasing manager will _____ with several suppliers before signing a contract.
questions.explanation: negotiate with 表示「與……協商」。
questions.translation: 採購經理會先與數家供應商協商，再簽訂合約。

questions.prompt: Because the speaker became ill, the seminar had to be _____.
questions.explanation: postpone 表示延期；被延期用 be postponed。
questions.translation: 由於講者生病，研討會必須延期。

questions.prompt: The warehouse manager checks the _____ every Friday to prevent shortages.
questions.explanation: inventory 指庫存。
questions.translation: 倉庫經理每週五檢查庫存，以避免短缺。

questions.prompt: Employees should attach receipts when requesting travel _____.
questions.explanation: travel reimbursement 指差旅費報銷。
questions.translation: 員工申請差旅費報銷時應附上收據。

questions.prompt: The laptop comes with a two-year _____ covering parts and labor.
questions.explanation: warranty 指產品保固。
questions.translation: 這台筆電附兩年零件與人工保固。

questions.prompt: The customer called to ask when her _____ would arrive.
questions.explanation: shipment 指一批運送中的貨物。
questions.translation: 顧客來電詢問她的貨物何時送達。

questions.prompt: The technology firm plans to _____ a smaller competitor.
questions.explanation: acquire a company 表示收購公司。
questions.translation: 這家科技公司計畫收購一家規模較小的競爭者。

questions.prompt: The company's annual _____ increased by twelve percent.
questions.explanation: revenue 指公司營收。
questions.translation: 公司的年度營收增加了百分之十二。

questions.prompt: Each _____ must submit a résumé and two references.
questions.explanation: applicant 指申請者、應徵者。
questions.translation: 每位應徵者都必須提交履歷與兩封推薦資料。

questions.prompt: Visitors can pick up a product _____ at the information desk.
questions.explanation: brochure 指介紹產品或服務的小冊子。
questions.translation: 訪客可在服務台索取產品簡介。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: Ms. Park from the sales department.
questions.explanation: 問 Who，應回答人。
questions.translation: 誰將負責這場簡報？
questions.audioText: Who will lead the presentation?
questions.audioTranslation: 誰將負責這場簡報？
questions.answerTranslation: 銷售部的 Park 女士。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: On the top shelf beside the printer.
questions.explanation: 問 Where，應回答地點。
questions.translation: 你把已簽署的合約放在哪裡？
questions.audioText: Where did you put the signed contracts?
questions.audioTranslation: 你把已簽署的合約放在哪裡？
questions.answerTranslation: 放在印表機旁邊的最上層架子上。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 問 When，應回答時間。
questions.translation: 維修人員預計何時抵達？
questions.audioText: When is the maintenance crew expected to arrive?
questions.audioTranslation: 維修人員預計何時抵達？
questions.answerTranslation: 中午以前的某個時間。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 問 Why，應回答原因。
questions.translation: 會議為什麼延期？
questions.audioText: Why was the meeting postponed?
questions.audioTranslation: 會議為什麼延期？
questions.answerTranslation: 主管的班機延誤了。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: How often 問頻率。
questions.translation: 這套設備多久檢查一次？
questions.audioText: How often is the equipment inspected?
questions.audioTranslation: 這套設備多久檢查一次？
questions.answerTranslation: 每三個月一次。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: Not at all. I'll send it right away.
questions.explanation: Would you mind...? 接受請求可回答 Not at all。
questions.translation: 可以麻煩你把修訂後的時程寄給我嗎？
questions.audioText: Would you mind sending me the revised schedule?
questions.audioTranslation: 可以麻煩你把修訂後的時程寄給我嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 當然不介意，我會立刻寄出。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 否定疑問句仍依事實回答；此處說明尚未寄出的原因。
questions.translation: 那些發票還沒寄出去嗎？
questions.audioText: Haven't the invoices been mailed yet?
questions.audioTranslation: 那些發票還沒寄出去嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 還沒，因為印表機故障了。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: Certainly. What time would you prefer?
The table is made of wood.
questions.explanation: 對請求最自然的回應是答應並確認時間。
questions.translation: 你可以幫今晚六個人訂位嗎？
questions.audioText: Could you reserve a table for six tonight?
questions.audioTranslation: 你可以幫今晚六個人訂位嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 當然，你希望幾點？

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: Which route 問路線選擇。
questions.translation: 我們去機場應該走哪條路？
questions.audioText: Which route should we take to the airport?
questions.audioTranslation: 我們去機場應該走哪條路？
questions.answerTranslation: 高速公路通常比較快。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: It closes at eight, so we still have time.
The sandwiches are on the counter.
questions.explanation: 回答營業狀態並提供時間。
questions.translation: 你知道員工餐廳是否還在營業嗎？
questions.audioText: Do you know whether the cafeteria is still open?
questions.audioTranslation: 你知道員工餐廳是否還在營業嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 它八點關門，所以我們還有時間。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: That sounds like a good idea.
questions.explanation: Why don't we...? 是提議。
questions.translation: 我們何不午餐後再審查提案？
questions.audioText: Why don't we review the proposal after lunch?
questions.audioTranslation: 我們何不午餐後再審查提案？
questions.answerTranslation: 聽起來是個好主意。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: How many 問數量。
questions.translation: 這份報告需要幾份副本？
questions.audioText: How many copies of the report do we need?
questions.audioTranslation: 這份報告需要幾份副本？
questions.answerTranslation: 二十份應該就夠了。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 依事實回答否定疑問句。
questions.translation: Gomez 先生不是要參加商展嗎？
questions.audioText: Isn't Mr. Gomez attending the trade show?
questions.audioTranslation: Gomez 先生不是要參加商展嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 沒有，他另有約會。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: I think it belongs to Ms. Lee.
questions.explanation: Whose 問所有人。
questions.translation: 門邊這把雨傘是誰的？
questions.audioText: Whose umbrella is this by the door?
questions.audioTranslation: 門邊這把雨傘是誰的？
questions.answerTranslation: 我想它是 Lee 女士的。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
questions.explanation: 服務情境中應確認座位供應狀況。
questions.translation: 可以給我一個走道座位嗎？
questions.audioText: Could I get an aisle seat, please?
questions.audioTranslation: 可以給我一個走道座位嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 我來查看看目前有哪些座位。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: It's much easier to move around now.
questions.explanation: What do you think of...? 問意見。
questions.translation: 你覺得新的辦公室配置如何？
questions.audioText: What do you think of the new office layout?
questions.audioTranslation: 你覺得新的辦公室配置如何？
questions.answerTranslation: 現在走動方便多了。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: It's printed on the last page.
questions.explanation: 問位置，回答在最後一頁。
questions.translation: 我在哪裡可以找到保固資訊？
questions.audioText: Where can I find the warranty information?
questions.audioTranslation: 我在哪裡可以找到保固資訊？
questions.answerTranslation: 它印在最後一頁。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: Call now, in case the office closes early.
questions.explanation: 選擇問句應直接給建議。
questions.translation: 我應該現在打給供應商，還是等到明天？
questions.audioText: Should I call the supplier now or wait until tomorrow?
questions.audioTranslation: 我應該現在打給供應商，還是等到明天？
questions.answerTranslation: 現在就打，以免辦公室提早關門。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: It went better than I expected.
questions.explanation: How was...? 問經驗或感受。
questions.translation: 你今天早上的面試如何？
questions.audioText: How was your interview this morning?
questions.audioTranslation: 你今天早上的面試如何？
questions.answerTranslation: 比我預期的順利。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response.
choices: Not yet, but they expect to finish today.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式 Yes/No 問句，回答目前狀態。
questions.translation: 財務部已經核准預算了嗎？
questions.audioText: Has the finance department approved the budget?
questions.audioTranslation: 財務部已經核准預算了嗎？
questions.answerTranslation: 還沒，不過他們預計今天完成。

questions.prompt: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: 對話重點是簡報時間改動。
questions.audioText: W: Hi, Daniel. The client moved tomorrow's product presentation from 10 A.M. to 2 P.M. M: Thanks for letting me know. I'll update the room reservation and notify the design team. W: Great. Please ask them to bring the revised brochures.
questions.audioTranslation: 女：嗨，Daniel。客戶把明天的產品簡報從上午十點改到下午兩點。男：謝謝你通知我。我會更新會議室預約並通知設計團隊。女：很好。請他們帶上修訂後的宣傳冊。

questions.prompt: What will the man do?
choices: Reserve a room and contact a team
Meet a supplier at the airport
questions.explanation: 男子說會更新會議室預約並通知設計團隊。
questions.audioText: W: Hi, Daniel. The client moved tomorrow's product presentation from 10 A.M. to 2 P.M. M: Thanks for letting me know. I'll update the room reservation and notify the design team. W: Great. Please ask them to bring the revised brochures.
questions.audioTranslation: 女：嗨，Daniel。客戶把明天的產品簡報從上午十點改到下午兩點。男：謝謝你通知我。我會更新會議室預約並通知設計團隊。女：很好。請他們帶上修訂後的宣傳冊。

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the design team to bring?
questions.explanation: 女子要求攜帶修訂後的小冊子。
questions.audioText: W: Hi, Daniel. The client moved tomorrow's product presentation from 10 A.M. to 2 P.M. M: Thanks for letting me know. I'll update the room reservation and notify the design team. W: Great. Please ask them to bring the revised brochures.
questions.audioTranslation: 女：嗨，Daniel。客戶把明天的產品簡報從上午十點改到下午兩點。男：謝謝你通知我。我會更新會議室預約並通知設計團隊。女：很好。請他們帶上修訂後的宣傳冊。

questions.prompt: Where most likely does the woman work?

They count movement patterns and send only hourly totals to a shared dashboard. Store owners say the data helps them decide when to schedule employees and when to prepare extra checkout stations.

The market association introduced the system after merchants complained that weekend staffing decisions were based mostly on guesses. However, the association also required each participating store to post a notice explaining what information is collected. A privacy review will be conducted after the first three months.

questions.explanation: 第一段說 sensors send only hourly totals to a shared dashboard。

questions.prompt: Not until the quarterly audit _____ the discrepancy visible to management.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 The discrepancy was not visible to management until the quarterly audit。visible 是形容詞，主要動詞是 was；Not until 置首後直接倒裝為 was the discrepancy visible。空格後已有主詞，不能再加入 it。
questions.translation: 直到季度稽核時，管理階層才看出這項差異。

questions.prompt: Not until the finance team compared both invoices _____ they discover the duplicate charge.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 They did not discover the duplicate charge until ...。discover 是一般動詞，Not until 置首後補過去式助動詞 did，並使用原形 discover。
questions.translation: 直到財務團隊比對兩張發票後，他們才發現重複收費。

questions.prompt: Only after the vendor sent the replacement parts _____ the machine resume production.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 The machine resumed production only after ...。resume 是一般動詞；Only after 置首後使用 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞：did the machine resume。
questions.translation: 直到供應商寄出替換零件後，機器才恢復生產。

questions.prompt: Only when the backup server came online _____ the team able to restore the archived files.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 The team was able to restore ... only when ...。be able to 的主要動詞是 was；Only when 置首後直接倒裝為 was the team able。
questions.translation: 只有在備援伺服器上線後，團隊才能還原封存檔案。

questions.prompt: Never before _____ the committee received so many proposals in a single week.
questions.explanation: received 在此是過去分詞；搭配 Never before 表示截至現在的經驗，使用現在完成式。Never 置首後將 has 移到主詞前：has the committee received。
questions.translation: 該委員會從未在一週內收到這麼多提案。

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ employees need to contact support after completing the guided installation.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 Employees seldom need to contact support。need 是一般動詞且描述一般情況；Seldom 置首後補 do：do employees need。
questions.translation: 員工完成引導式安裝後，很少需要聯絡技術支援。

questions.prompt: Rarely _____ the loading area this quiet during regular business hours.
questions.explanation: this quiet 是形容詞補語，句子的主要動詞是 is。Rarely 置首後直接將 be 動詞放在主詞前：is the loading area this quiet。
questions.translation: 正常營業時間內，裝卸區很少如此安靜。

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ visitors enter the clean room without an authorized badge.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances 是否定限制片語，置首後主句部分倒裝。原句已有情態動詞 may，直接移到主詞 visitors 前：may visitors enter。
questions.translation: 訪客在任何情況下都不得未持授權識別證進入無塵室。

questions.prompt: Little _____ the project manager know that the vendor had already shipped the revised samples.
questions.explanation: Little 在此表示「完全沒料到」，具有否定語意。know 是一般動詞，Little 置首後補過去式助動詞 did：Little did the project manager know。
questions.translation: 專案經理完全不知道供應商早已寄出修訂樣品。

questions.prompt: No sooner _____ the contract been signed than the legal department requested an amendment.
questions.explanation: 固定句型是 No sooner had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + than ...，表示前一動作剛完成，下一動作立刻發生。been signed 已是完成式被動，因此選 had。
questions.translation: 合約才剛簽署，法務部門就要求修訂。

questions.prompt: Hardly _____ the webinar begun when the connection failed.
questions.explanation: 固定句型是 Hardly had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when ...。begun 是 begin 的過去分詞，因此使用 had the webinar begun。
questions.translation: 網路研討會才剛開始，連線就中斷了。

questions.prompt: Not only _____ the update improve security, but it also reduced loading times.
questions.explanation: Not only 置於句首且修飾主要子句時要部分倒裝。improve 是原形，後文 reduced 顯示過去時間，因此使用 did the update improve。
questions.translation: 這次更新不僅提升安全性，也縮短了載入時間。

questions.prompt: At no time _____ customer records accessible from the public network.
questions.explanation: accessible 是形容詞補語，主要動詞是 were。At no time 置首後將 be 動詞移到主詞 customer records 前：were customer records accessible。
questions.translation: 客戶資料從未能透過公共網路存取。

questions.prompt: Only then _____ the finance team understand why the totals did not match.
questions.explanation: understand 是一般動詞，Only then 置首後要部分倒裝。句意描述過去事件，因此補 did，並保留原形 understand。
questions.translation: 直到那時，財務團隊才明白總額為何不一致。

questions.prompt: On no account _____ confidential files be sent through a personal e-mail account.
questions.explanation: On no account 表示「絕不」，置首後要倒裝。句中已有被動原形 be sent，前面需接情態動詞 should：should confidential files be sent。
questions.translation: 機密檔案絕不可透過私人電子郵件帳號寄送。

questions.prompt: Nowhere else _____ customers obtain the same repair service on weekends.
questions.explanation: Nowhere else 具有否定限制語意，置首後要部分倒裝。原句的情態動詞 can 移到主詞 customers 前：can customers obtain。
questions.translation: 顧客在其他任何地方都無法於週末取得同樣的維修服務。

questions.prompt: So effective _____ the revised schedule that all delayed inspections were completed by Friday.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 The revised schedule was so effective that ...。So + 形容詞置首強調時，將 be 動詞移到主詞前：So effective was the revised schedule。
questions.translation: 修訂後的時程非常有效，使所有延誤的檢查都在週五前完成。

questions.prompt: Such _____ the demand for the workshop that a second session was added.
questions.explanation: 正常語序是 The demand for the workshop was such that ...。Such 置首強調時，be 動詞移到主詞前：Such was the demand。
questions.translation: 工作坊需求如此熱烈，因此加開了第二場。

questions.prompt: Neither _____ the supplier issue a refund, nor did it offer a replacement.
questions.explanation: Neither 置首表示兩項否定時，第一個子句要倒裝。issue 是原形且後半句使用 did，故為 Neither did the supplier issue ... nor did it offer ...。
questions.translation: 供應商既未退款，也未提供替換品。

questions.prompt: The first quotation did not include installation, and neither _____ the revised quotation.
questions.explanation: neither 表示後者也同樣不包含。前句使用 did not include，後句省略重複動詞 include，保留倒裝結構 neither did the revised quotation。
questions.translation: 第一份報價未包含安裝費，修訂後的報價也沒有。

questions.prompt: The original estimate has not been approved, nor _____ the revised budget.
questions.explanation: 前句使用現在完成式 has not been approved。nor 連接相同否定情況時要倒裝，並沿用助動詞 has：nor has the revised budget。
questions.translation: 原始估價尚未核准，修訂後的預算也尚未核准。

questions.prompt: _____ you require a printed receipt, select that option before submitting the form.
questions.explanation: Should you require ... 等於 If you should require ...。條件句省略 if 後，將 should 移到主詞 you 前；這是正式商務用語。
questions.translation: 如果您需要紙本收據，請在送出表單前選取該選項。

questions.prompt: _____ the supplier to miss the second deadline, the contract would automatically be reviewed.
questions.explanation: Were the supplier to miss ... 等於 If the supplier were to miss ...，表示較不可能的未來假設。Were + 主詞 + to V 是正式條件倒裝。
questions.translation: 若供應商再次錯過期限，合約將自動進入審查。

questions.prompt: _____ the maintenance team known about the voltage issue, it would have tested the circuit first.
questions.explanation: Had the maintenance team known ... 等於 If the maintenance team had known ...。這是與過去事實相反的條件句，省略 if 後將 had 移到主詞前。
questions.translation: 如果維修團隊早知道電壓問題，就會先測試電路。

questions.prompt: Employees _____ at remote construction sites must complete the safety module before arrival.
questions.explanation: working at remote construction sites 是 who work at remote construction sites 的省略形式。employees 主動在工地工作，因此使用現在分詞 working。
questions.translation: 在偏遠工地工作的員工必須在抵達前完成安全課程。

questions.prompt: The mobile application, _____ in March, now supports biometric sign-in.
questions.explanation: launched in March 省略了 which was launched in March。application 是被推出，使用過去分詞 launched。
questions.translation: 這款於三月推出的行動應用程式現在支援生物辨識登入。

questions.prompt: Once _____ by the legal department, the agreement will be sent to the client.
questions.explanation: Once approved 省略了 Once it is approved。agreement 與 approve 是被動關係，因此用過去分詞 approved。
questions.translation: 協議一經法務部核准，就會寄給客戶。

questions.prompt: _____ within walking distance of the convention center, the hotel is popular with exhibitors.
questions.explanation: the hotel is located... 為被動狀態，句首省略主詞與 be 動詞後使用 Located。
questions.translation: 這家飯店位於會議中心步行可達之處，因此很受參展商歡迎。

questions.prompt: Customers _____ to participate in the beta test will receive setup instructions by e-mail.
questions.explanation: invited to participate 省略了 who are invited to participate。customers 是被邀請的對象，因此用過去分詞 invited。
questions.translation: 受邀參加測試版試用的顧客將透過電子郵件收到設定說明。

questions.prompt: While _____ the replacement battery, the technician noticed a damaged connector.
questions.explanation: While installing 省略了 While the technician was installing。technician 主動安裝電池，因此用現在分詞 installing。
questions.translation: 技術人員安裝替換電池時，注意到一個受損的接頭。

questions.prompt: Unless _____ otherwise in writing, all quotations remain valid for thirty days.
questions.explanation: Unless stated otherwise 省略了 Unless it is stated otherwise，是正式商務文件常見的被動省略句。
questions.translation: 除非另有書面說明，所有報價的有效期均為三十天。

questions.prompt: The files _____ in the encrypted folder can be accessed only by project leaders.
questions.explanation: stored in the encrypted folder 省略了 that are stored...。files 是被儲存，因此使用過去分詞 stored。
questions.translation: 儲存在加密資料夾中的檔案只有專案主管可以存取。

questions.prompt: When _____ on a tablet, the dashboard automatically rearranges its panels.
questions.explanation: When viewed on a tablet 省略了 When it is viewed on a tablet。dashboard 是被觀看，使用過去分詞 viewed。
questions.translation: 儀表板在平板上檢視時，會自動重新排列面板。

questions.prompt: The auditor recommended that each branch _____ its access records every quarter.
questions.explanation: recommend that + 主詞 + 原形動詞是要求／建議類假設語氣，因此使用 review，不隨主詞 each branch 加 -s。
questions.translation: 稽核員建議每間分公司每季檢查其存取紀錄。

questions.prompt: It is essential that backup copies _____ in a location separate from the main server.
questions.explanation: It is essential that... 後使用原形假設語氣；copies 與 store 是被動關係，所以用 be stored。
questions.translation: 備份副本必須存放在與主伺服器不同的位置。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ahmed requested that the vendor _____ the delivery schedule before noon.
questions.explanation: request that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，表示正式要求，因此使用 revise。
questions.translation: Ahmed 女士要求供應商在中午前修訂交貨時程。

questions.prompt: It is vital that every access request _____ by two supervisors.
questions.explanation: It is vital that... 後用原形假設語氣；request 是被核准，故為 be approved。
questions.translation: 每項存取申請都必須由兩名主管核准。

questions.prompt: The consultant suggested that the launch date _____ until the security review was complete.
questions.explanation: suggest that... 採原形假設語氣；launch date 與 postpone 是被動關係，因此使用 be postponed。
questions.translation: 顧問建議將上線日期延後到安全審查完成後。

questions.prompt: The policy requires that no visitor _____ unattended in the laboratory.
questions.explanation: require that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，因此 no visitor 後仍使用 remain。
questions.translation: 政策要求任何訪客都不得在實驗室內無人陪同。

questions.prompt: If the prototype _____ more reliable, the company would demonstrate it at the trade fair.
questions.explanation: 主句 would demonstrate 表示與現在情況相反或可能性低的假設；be 動詞正式使用 were。
questions.translation: 如果這個原型更可靠，公司就會在商展中展示它。

questions.prompt: The manager asked that the confidential draft _____ after the meeting.
questions.explanation: ask that... 表正式要求，後接原形假設語氣；draft 是被銷毀，故選 be destroyed。
questions.translation: 經理要求會議結束後銷毀機密草稿。

questions.prompt: It was proposed that the unused office _____ into a customer training room.
questions.explanation: It was proposed that... 後採原形假設語氣；office 是被改建，因此用 be converted。
questions.translation: 有人提議將閒置辦公室改建成顧客培訓室。

questions.prompt: _____ the revised budget, the committee approved the project without further discussion.
questions.explanation: 先審閱預算，之後才核准專案。Having + p.p. 表示分詞構句的動作早於主句，因此選 Having reviewed。
questions.translation: 審閱修訂後的預算後，委員會未再討論便核准了專案。

questions.prompt: Not _____ the building's access code, the courier called the reception desk.
questions.explanation: courier 主動知道／不知道密碼，否定分詞構句用 Not knowing。
questions.translation: 由於不知道大樓門禁密碼，快遞員打電話給接待櫃台。

questions.prompt: _____ for high-volume transactions, the new payment system can process requests within seconds.
questions.explanation: payment system 是被設計來處理大量交易，使用過去分詞 Designed 作被動分詞構句。
questions.translation: 這套新付款系統專為大量交易設計，可在數秒內處理請求。

questions.prompt: _____ with the previous model, the updated scanner uses considerably less power.
questions.explanation: Compared with... 是固定的被動分詞片語，表示「與……相比」。scanner 是被拿來比較的對象。
questions.translation: 與前一款相比，更新後的掃描器耗電量明顯較低。

questions.prompt: _____ the encrypted portal, employees can submit expense documents from any branch.
questions.explanation: employees 主動使用 portal，且使用與提交同時發生，因此用現在分詞 Using。
questions.translation: 員工可使用加密入口網站，從任何分公司提交費用文件。

questions.prompt: _____ of the route change in advance, the driver avoided the closed bridge.
questions.explanation: driver 先被通知，之後避開封閉橋梁。用 Having been + p.p. 同時表達先發生與被動。
questions.translation: 司機事先收到路線變更通知，因此避開了封閉的橋梁。

questions.prompt: _____ with an unexpected shortage, the manufacturer contacted two alternative suppliers.
questions.explanation: be faced with 是「面臨」的固定結構，省略 be 後成為 Faced with...。
questions.translation: 面臨突發短缺，製造商聯絡了兩家替代供應商。

questions.prompt: _____ on three years of usage data, the forecast predicts a steady increase in demand.
questions.explanation: the forecast is based on data，省略 be 動詞後使用 Based on...。forecast 與 base 是被動關係。
questions.translation: 這項預測以三年的使用資料為基礎，預計需求將穩定成長。

questions.prompt: _____ all required safety checks, the engineers authorized the system restart.
questions.explanation: 工程師先完成檢查，才授權重新啟動。Having completed 清楚表示先後順序。
questions.translation: 完成所有必要的安全檢查後，工程師核准重新啟動系統。

questions.prompt: The new routing system will not only reduce delivery time but also _____ fuel efficiency.
questions.explanation: not only reduce... but also improve... 要保持原形動詞平行，因此選 improve。
questions.translation: 新的路線系統不僅會縮短配送時間，也會提高燃油效率。

questions.prompt: The coordinator is responsible for scheduling interviews, monitoring attendance, and _____ final reports.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 for 後的三項工作為 scheduling、monitoring、preparing，必須保持 V-ing 平行。
questions.translation: 協調員負責安排面試、追蹤出席情況及準備最終報告。

questions.prompt: The revised dashboard is both accurate and _____ to interpret.
questions.explanation: both A and B 連接相同語法角色；accurate 是形容詞，因此 B 也用形容詞 easy。
questions.translation: 修訂後的儀表板既準確又容易解讀。

questions.prompt: Applicants may either upload the certificate online or _____ a printed copy in person.
questions.explanation: either upload... or submit... 連接兩個原形動詞，故使用 submit。
questions.translation: 申請人可以在線上上傳證書，或親自提交紙本。

questions.prompt: The initiative aims to shorten waiting times, reduce paperwork, and _____ customer satisfaction.
questions.explanation: aims to 後接三個平行原形動詞：shorten、reduce、improve。
questions.translation: 這項計畫旨在縮短等候時間、減少文書作業並提高顧客滿意度。

questions.prompt: The new approval process is faster than the previous one and _____ to audit.
questions.explanation: faster 與 easier 都是比較級形容詞，平行描述 new approval process。
questions.translation: 新的核准流程比舊流程更快，也更容易稽核。

questions.prompt: The board will decide whether the company renews the lease or _____ to a smaller office.
questions.explanation: whether A or B 連接兩個子句；前半是 the company renews，後半省略相同主詞後仍需第三人稱單數 relocates。
questions.translation: 董事會將決定公司要續租，還是搬到較小的辦公室。

questions.prompt: The role requires preparing budgets, negotiating contracts, and _____ vendor performance.
questions.explanation: requires 後列舉三項工作，preparing、negotiating、evaluating 必須保持 V-ing 平行。
questions.translation: 這個職位需要編製預算、洽談合約及評估供應商表現。

questions.prompt: The report was praised for its clear organization, concise language, and _____ recommendations.
questions.explanation: clear、concise、practical 都是形容詞，分別修飾 organization、language、recommendations，形成平行名詞片語。
questions.translation: 這份報告因組織清楚、語言精簡及建議實用而受到肯定。

questions.passage:
Hybrid Work Access Policy

Employees may work from a branch other than their assigned office up to six days per month. They must reserve a workstation by 4 P.M. on the previous business day. Same-day reservations are permitted only when a manager confirms that the visit is related to an urgent client request. Staff attending scheduled training do not need to use the workstation system; the Learning Department reserves seats for them automatically. However, anyone extending a training visit for personal work must book the additional time separately.
questions.prompt: What is the maximum number of days an employee may normally work from another branch each month?
questions.explanation: 政策第一句直接規定每月上限為 six days。
questions.evidence: Employees may work from a branch other than their assigned office up to six days per month.
choiceNotes: 把預約截止時間 4 P.M. 誤當成天數。
正解：up to six days 明確給出每月上限。

However, anyone extending a training visit for personal work must book the additional time separately.
questions.prompt: Under what condition is a same-day workstation reservation allowed?
choices: The employee is attending scheduled training
The branch has more than six empty desks
A manager confirms an urgent client-related visit
questions.explanation: only when 引出唯一允許當日預約的條件：主管確認是緊急客戶需求。
questions.evidence: Same-day reservations are permitted only when a manager confirms that the visit is related to an urgent client request.
questions.evidenceLocation: 第 3 句｜only when 限制條件
choiceNotes: 訓練人員根本不必使用預約系統，不是當日預約條件。
文件沒有以空桌數作為條件。
正解：主管確認且與緊急客戶需求有關。
4 P.M. 是前一個工作日的截止時間，不是到訪當天。

questions.passage:
Device Return Procedure

Before returning a company laptop, employees should upload active project files to the secure transfer folder. Next, they must submit the online return form; the system then creates a tracking label. The laptop and its power adapter should be placed in the reusable shipping sleeve, but external keyboards should remain at the employee's office. After the courier scans the label, the employee receives an automatic receipt. IT will close the equipment record only after confirming that the device starts normally and that no accessories are missing.
questions.prompt: What should employees do first before returning a laptop?
questions.explanation: Before returning... 的第一個動作是上傳進行中的專案檔案。
questions.evidence: Before returning a company laptop, employees should upload active project files to the secure transfer folder.
choiceNotes: 正解：這是文件列出的第一個動作。
收據在快遞掃描標籤後才自動產生。
標籤需要貼在退回物品上，不是移除。
外接鍵盤應留在辦公室。

questions.evidence: Next, they must submit the online return form; the system then creates a tracking label.
choiceNotes: IT 要等裝置檢查完成才關閉紀錄。
收據要等快遞掃描標籤。
正解：表單送出後系統建立 tracking label。
裝置測試由 IT 後續確認，不是自動立即發生。

questions.passage:
BUILDING NOTICE

Greenline Tower will test emergency power on September 12 from 7 to 9 A.M. Elevators will operate one at a time, and tenants are asked to postpone nonessential deliveries until after 9:30. The loading dock will remain open for urgent medical and food shipments.

E-MAIL
From: Lena Cho, Brightwell Events
To: Setup Crew
Subject: September 12 Delivery

Our stage equipment is scheduled to arrive at Greenline Tower at 8 A.M. on September 12. The cases are heavy and require two elevator trips.
